node_definition.done_when: Done when a new tests/test_the_router_decides_on_preferences.py shows five things, with stub lane windows, a stub lane document, and a stub Jev that records the candidate set it was given: With a lift in force on codex and the local lane full, a guided implement node that declares no reasoning requirement, so it sits below the reservation's tier floor, reaches Jev with codex in its candidate set, marked reserved and lifted. The dispatch is placed on codex when Jev chooses it. With no lift in force, the same node still reaches Jev with codex in its set, marked reserved with no lift. A node whose context exceeds the local window reaches Jev without the local lane, and a paused lane is never offered. With Jev unavailable, the fallback holds the unlifted reserved lane for an ordinary node, as §54 does today, and places a low-think node on the local lane when it has room. A review node is never offered a metered lane. Two negative controls each make one case fail. Restoring the reserved-lane exclusion fails the first case. Offering a lane that fails context fit fails the third. A timing arm on the fleet node logs one live pick for each of the two nodes above, with the lift in force, to a log under the run directory that starts with its revision and the literal command and ends in EXIT= : neither answers hold , and the low-think node is placed on local while local has room. The test files importing reckon.crew.picker , reckon.crew.picker.snapshot and reckon.crew.dispatch_picker add no failure against the base revision. Ruff adds no findings on the staged paths. Two landed tests assert the exclusion this section removes, and the node rewrites those assertions to the new rule rather than deleting them: tests/test_a_reserved_lane_reads_its_published_window.py (near lines 366–369) and tests/test_an_oversize_node_reaches_a_reserved_lane.py (near lines 188 and 285–306). Each now asserts that codex is offered, marked reserved, with or without a lift. Write paths: reckon/crew/picker/snapshot.py , reckon/crew/picker/__init__.py , the picker's prompt module under reckon/crew/picker/ , those two test files, and the new test.
